chapter: First jobs and the piano scene
title: Ham and Egg Blues and playing with Louis Keppard at a cabaret
summary: He recalls Juby's Ham and Egg Blues, and a night with Louis Keppard at a cabaret near the French Market, playing Spanish Town repeatedly.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: What we played: tunes and repertoire in the early days

blocks.x: Did you have any numbers of your own that you used to play? Any blues of your own or anything like that?
No, I... I never did take that. I had another... Another blues my brother used to play. I used to play all the time. They called the Ham and Egg Blues.
Yeah, who used to play that?
My brother, Juby, used to play that. Called Ham and Egg Blues. He used to play that. I played that one night. But... And that at the Miles' place there. I was playing with... With... Louis Kepin.

Yeah. Yeah. I played with Louis Kepin one night at that... At Head of the Miles' place. That was... Sanan in... In Decayla. They had a cabaret there. And I was playing there. And we played that Spanish town... About... Or recall man. About ten times we played that. I played that on piano.
Is that the place down by the French market? Yeah.
By the French market. Right by that's... Jackson Square. Right by that's Jackson Square.
Yeah. It's where Fernandez Wine Cellar is now. Is that the... A store that sells liquor?
I don't know what they got. I don't know what's there now. It'll be right at that corner. Right on the corner.
They got a liquor store right now.
What is that now? Yeah. They call that the Pond Alba building now.
No way. It wasn't saying to St. Peland. Yeah. St. Peland Decayla.
